metric.definition: macro mean IoU over classes present in target or prediction, confusion matrix accumulated over the full validation split (torchmetrics multiclass JaccardIndex convention, as in geo-bench-experiments)
metric.name: miou

rationale: Selected using validation only: mean IoU improved from 0.8338 to 0.8477 and cattle IoU from 0.6762 to 0.7035. Best checkpoint at epoch 20. Higher-resolution recipe was proposed manually. Test split remains untouched.
